description_html:
The Wacom One Standard Pen offers a cordless and battery-free drawing experience. Powered by EMR (Electro-Magnetic Resonance) technology, this pen was especially designed for the new Wacom One pen tablets and displays. With its ergonomic design and two side switches, you can easily access customizable shortcuts and commands, enhancing your workflow and creativity.  With this customization feature, you can tailor the look of your pen to reflect your individual style and preferences, adding a touch of personalization to your creative experience.

Compatible with: 

Wacom One 12

Wacom One 14 

Wacom One 13 TOUCH 

Wacom One S and M
